","form_description":"

Verifying your product through the official HiddenTag app is the fastest and most reliable way to confirm that it is genuine.

If you are experiencing any difficulties with the app or require further assistance, our team will be glad to support you. Please kindly complete the form below and provide as much detail as possible about your product so we can review your inquiry carefully.

Every submission is thoroughly reviewed as part of our ongoing efforts to protect our community and ensure the authenticity of AXIS-Y products.

As we receive a high volume of inquiries each day, we kindly ask for your patience while our team evaluates your request and prepares an appropriate response.
